class WorkItem:
    def __init__(self, kind, parent=None):
        self.kind = kind
        self.parent = parent
        self.meta = {}

def process_batch(rows, parent, schedule):
    for row in rows:
        for value in row:
            item = WorkItem("cell", parent=parent)
            item.meta["value"] = value
            schedule(lambda i=item: finalize(i))
